strengths: Correctly identifies a pigmented epithelial identity from PMEL/DCT/TYRP1/MITF/RAB38 plus KRT8/KRT18
Recognizes RPE-associated markers SERPINF1, RBP1, HSD17B2, GJA1, TMEM98
Appropriately treats ECM/fibroblast-like genes as non-overriding in the context of RPE
weaknesses: Some proposed EMT/substate refinements are less directly anchored in the ORIGINAL DEG list
Tissue-context reasoning is used beyond the original marker evidence to argue against melanocyte

strengths: Recognizes the dominant melanogenic/pigment program (PMEL, DCT, TYRP1, MITF, RAB38)
weaknesses: Ignores strong epithelial markers KRT8/KRT18 and RPE-associated markers SERPINF1/RBP1/HSD17B2
Provides no melanocyte-specific branch evidence to override the CL:0002586 majority

strengths: Pigmentation, melanosome organization and MITF-M pathway enrichment are consistent with pigment cell identity
Converges with the non-hierarchical majority CLID CL:0002586
weaknesses: Relies substantially on shared pigment markers that also fit melanocyte
Less explicit about the epithelial/RPE-distinguishing evidence (KRT8/KRT18, RBP1, SERPINF1)

supporting: Top DEGs PMEL, DCT, TYRP1, MITF, RAB38, GPR143, GPNMB establish a pigmented cell identity
Epithelial DEGs KRT8 and KRT18 support pigment epithelium over melanocyte
RPE-associated DEGs SERPINF1, RBP1, HSD17B2, GJA1, TMEM98 support CL:0002586
Original enrichment for pigmentation, melanosome organization and MITF-M-dependent gene expression is consistent with RPE
conflicting: Melanocyte candidate is not supported by branch-specific ORIGINAL evidence; shared pigmentation markers cannot distinguish melanocyte from RPE and do not override the CL:0002586 majority
